consolidated_repair_register.symptom: Running tools/verify-package.ps1 -Zip <zip> -ReferenceModel qwen3.8:27b sequentially under Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9818 and PowerShell 7.6.9 passes PASS packaged two-turn local reference-model conversation using qwen3.8:27b (line 484), then fails at line 169 with 'Shutdown timeout' in Close-Session (line 487) immediately after Close-Dialog $chat (line 486).
consolidated_repair_register.root_cause: Calling Expand() + Select-AtlasItem on the Model ComboBox inside modal ReferenceWindow leaves Model.IsDropDownOpen=true and creates a PopupRoot HWND after which UIA WindowPattern.Close() in Close-Dialog returns without closing ReferenceWindow, blocking WorkWindow.Close() in Close-Session. Isolated UIA diagnostics proved offline Close-Dialog succeeds and WM_CLOSE (PostMessage hwnd 0x0010) closes ReferenceWindow cleanly.
consolidated_repair_register.required_repair: Collapse the Model ComboBox dropdown upon selection in desktop/ReferenceWindow.xaml.cs (Model.IsDropDownOpen = false), and harden Close-Dialog in tools/verify-package.ps1 to collapse any expanded popup, fall back to WM_CLOSE (0x0010) if WindowPattern.Close() does not close the dialog HWND, and wait for dialog dismissal before calling Close-Session. Re-run unmodified tools/verify-package.ps1 -Zip <zip> -ReferenceModel qwen3.8:27b sequentially under both PS 5.1 and PS 7.6.9.

consolidated_repair_register.symptom: ResearchPlan.IsValid() validates pipe-delimited Fields with StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries and ResearchWindow.Prepare trims UI text boxes, whereas direct programmatic callers passing untrimmed plan.Fields to Engine.Study(plan) enter review and then fail closed at FinishProjectAnswer because SubmitCore trims task.Request while task.Plan.Request remains untrimmed.
consolidated_repair_register.recommended_fix: Normalize Objective and Fields with .Trim() inside Engine.Study (or ResearchPlan.Normalized()) so programmatic callers match ResearchWindow.Prepare without weakening Finish fail-closed checks.
